events.verdict: Carter Jr. (ORL) extends his left arm toward the ball and marginal contact occurs with Antetokounmpo's (MIL) body as Carter Jr. contests the shot at the basket.

Replay review of the foul called on Trent Jr. (MIL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Trent Jr. reaches in and initiates contact with Banchero's (ORL) wrist during his upward shooting motion, which affects the jump shot attempt.
Carter Jr. (ORL) makes clean contact with the ball to tie it up with Antetokounmpo (MIL) and a jump ball is correctly called.
Carter Jr. (ORL) grabs and holds Antetokounmpo's (MIL) right arm, which affects his ability to get to the ball during jump ball.
Lillard (MIL) moves into and initiates contact with Banchero's (ORL) body, affecting the shot attempt.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Lillard (MIL) throws an errant pass that goes out of bounds and possession is correctly awarded to the Magic.
Banchero (ORL) gathers the ball on his right foot and establishes his left as his pivot. He legally lifts his pivot foot and releases his pass prior to his pivot foot returning to the ground.
Trent Jr. (MIL) grasps and then quickly releases Banchero's (ORL) jersey before Banchero cleanly secures the post entry pass.
Middleton (MIL) legally contests da Silva's (ORL) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Carter Jr. (ORL) initiates illegal contact with Lopez's (MIL) arm during the rebound.
Carter Jr. (ORL) slightly extends his left arm into Antetokounmpo's (MIL) path and marginal contact occurs during the screen.
Trent Jr. (MIL) is retreating his arm into a vertical position and absorbs the marginal contact that occurs with Banchero (ORL) after his gather.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) legally contests Banchero's (ORL) jump shot attempt.
Carter Jr. (ORL) reaches in and makes illegal contact with Lopez's (MIL) arm.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) makes contact with Banchero's (ORL) right wrist prior to the release, which affects his jump shot attempt.

Replay review of the foul called on Black (ORL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Black moves into and initiates illegal contact with Lillard's (MIL) body, which affects Lillard's SQBR.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) and Banchero (ORL) engage and disengage with one another while boxing out during the free throw attempt.
Lopez (MIL) briefly grasps and quickly releases Carter Jr.'s (ORL) arm as marginal contact occurs when they briefly jostle for rebounding position.
Lillard (MIL) moves laterally into Anthony's (ORL) path and initiates body contact that affects Anthony's SQBR in the backcourt.
Anthony (ORL) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Lopez (MIL).

The officials blow the play dead for a clock malfunction as the clock never started after Lopez (MIL) secured the rebound off Anthony's (ORL) missed free-throw attempt. After review, it is determined that Orlando would have possession of the ball with 0.4 seconds left on the game clock.
Carter Jr. (ORL) firms up in Antetokounmpo's (MIL) path and marginal contact occurs as they mutually engage and immediately disengage during the screen.

Banchero (ORL) does not release the shot attempt prior to the expiration of the game clock and the officials correctly waive it off. Antetokounmpo (MIL) avoids making any contact with Banchero prior to the expiration of the game clock.
